name: When should I hire a project manager for a multi-family development?

mainEntity.name: When should I hire a project manager for a multi-family development?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is advisable to engage a project manager early in the multi-family development process, ideally during the initial planning and feasibility stages. Their involvement from the outset ensures effective site selection, preliminary design review, accurate cost estimation, and robust scheduling. Early engagement helps establish clear objectives, identify potential challenges, and streamline permitting processes, laying a strong foundation for successful execution and avoiding costly delays or changes later in the project lifecycle.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a project manager early in the multi-family development process, during initial planning, to ensure effective site selection, accurate cost estimation, and streamlined execution.
